notes: Large-source-unit candidate מִלִּפְנֵי → *from* retained: one English word carries the whole relation, no morpheme owns a part of it, and the three morphemes are contiguous, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met; headed on the construct noun פָּנֶה (rule 23).
The first *which* is `added`: the Hebrew relative clause is asyndetic and the antecedent רָעָה is written, so rule 46's headless case does not reach it (rule 55).

כְּ → *as it were* kept whole as one rendering carrying the construction's dummy and copula (rule 30); the competing reading, giving *it were* to the predicate noun under rule 20, is named in the unit note.
